title: Synthesis Task File
description: A muninn synthesis task file (contract muninn-synthesis/1, docs/synthesis-contract.md). Self-contained: it carries the instructions, the materials and the result schema, so any harness can run it. One envelope for era_narrative, deep_pass, ad_hoc_analysis and lint tasks.

task_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of this object without task_digest. Present in every emitted task file; a result file echoes it.

attempt.description: 1 for the first attempt; 2 for the single self-correction retry, which carries correction_instructions.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the task file was built.

instructions.description: The system prompt for whichever model runs the task.

result_schema.description: The JSON Schema the result's output must validate against.

tag.description: lint: the tag the compared pages share.

correction_instructions.description: Populated on retry attempts. Contains the validation errors from the prior attempt the model must fix.

materials.description: Task-specific input payload. Era passes bookmarks+neighbors; deep_pass passes source_text+known_bookmark_ids; ad_hoc passes corpus subset; lint passes pages sharing a tag.
